description: AM35 DPI value setter (set_dpixy) uses RACE raceId 0x30C4. Params stage (u8 at offset 6, 1-based), dpiX (le-u16 at offset 7), dpiY (le-u16 at offset 9). RACE framing: [0x05, 0x5A, length_le_u16, raceId_le_u16, ...params]. No request checksum. Source: disassembly/AM35model.dis set_dpixy. Getter 0x30C5 returns DPI state with dpiX array@11 and dpiY array@27 (parsers.json am35-dpi); verify uses indexParam=stage (1-based) to select the array element.

readback.comment: dpiX array at offset 11 (8x le-u16): [416, 800, 1600, 3200, 6400, 12800, 25600, 51200]. dpiY array at offset 27 (8x le-u16): same values. verify assertion uses indexParam=stage (1-based) to check dpiX[stage-1] and dpiY[stage-1].
